MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL: risk and cycle signals are N/A; Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive, with Technology and Energy negative while seven sectors advanced. Leadership: neither narrow nor broad (Top 5 spread across 3 sectors); mixed sector performance and unavailable regime signals argue against a stronger call.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Communication leads (+5.62% 1W), with CHTR (1W: +17.81% | 1M: +30.82%) ABOVE TREND and TTWO (1W: +15.21% | 1M: +7.58%) ABOVE TREND; Consumer Discretionary gained 3.40%, led by LOW (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +25.74%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate was third by weekly sector return (+2.62%); constituent performance details were not provided.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy (-6.52% 1W) is weakest: XOM (1W: -7.32% | 1M: -4.46%) and PSX (1W: -7.81% | 1M: -10.93%) are BELOW TREND. Technology (-1.94%) and Utilities (-0.51%) also lag; NVDA (1W: -18.29% | 1M: -25.38%) and SRE (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -4.27%) are BELOW TREND.

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: CHTR (1W: +17.81% | 1M: +30.82%), TTWO (1W: +15.21% | 1M: +7.58%), NEM (1W: +11.62% | 1M: +2.40%), TMUS (1W: +9.50% | 1M: +11.33%) and LOW (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +25.74%) are all ABOVE TREND. Leadership: neither narrow nor broad (3 sectors represented), with Communication names prominent.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
DOW (1W: -6.84% | 1M: +11.95%) is in CORRECTION; WMB (1W: -6.91% | 1M: -9.05%), XOM (1W: -7.32% | 1M: -4.46%), PSX (1W: -7.81% | 1M: -10.93%) and SRE (1W: -8.18% | 1M: -4.27%) are BELOW TREND. Weakness clusters in Energy, with one short-term pullback in Materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves include CHTR (1W: +17.81% | 1M: +30.82%) and TTWO (1W: +15.21% | 1M: +7.58%), both ABOVE TREND. Major divergence is present: MSFT (1W: +2.34% | 1M: -1.48%), GOOGL (1W: +2.62% | 1M: -18.52%) and META (1W: +3.28% | 1M: -13.67%) are RECOVERY; watch for trend break.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is weak: NVDA (1W: -18.29% | 1M: -25.38%) and NOW (1W: -8.75% | 1M: -29.01%) are BELOW TREND, while AAPL (1W: +5.00% | 1M: +2.21%) is ABOVE TREND. Sector return was -1.94% for the week and -10.94% for the month; constituent-positive breadth was not supplied (24 stocks).

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials gained 1.10% for the week and 3.33% for the month; JPM (1W: +1.21% | 1M: +2.32%), V (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +8.87%) and MA (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +10.71%) are ABOVE TREND. Constituent-positive breadth was not supplied (20 stocks), so style leadership remains mixed rather than confirmed.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare advanced 1.88% for the week and 8.88% for the month; LLY (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +21.11%) and UNH (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +7.03%) are ABOVE TREND. Constituent-positive breadth was not supplied (17 stocks); UNH’s positive price trend contrasts with negative news sentiment.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor select Communication and Consumer Discretionary strength, while monitoring Technology and Energy weakness; style mixed / no clear leadership. Major divergences in large-cap technology argue for restraint: treat the rebounds as tactical, not confirmed trend reversals.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Monitor CHTR (1W: +17.81% | 1M: +30.82%) and LOW (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +25.74%), both ABOVE TREND, for continued momentum. BEARISH: Watch NVDA (1W: -18.29% | 1M: -25.38%) and XOM (1W: -7.32% | 1M: -4.46%), both BELOW TREND, for further weakness.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Communication (+5.62% 1W) and Consumer Discretionary (+3.40%) have the strongest sector momentum; constituent breadth was not supplied. BEARISH: Energy (-6.52%) and Technology (-1.94%) are weakest; overall breadth is 7/11 sectors positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels were not supplied. Monitor whether ABOVE TREND leaders sustain positive weekly returns and whether BELOW TREND Technology and Energy names stabilize; large-cap recovery patterns need confirmation.

NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
MA (+45): Bernstein raised its price target; MA (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +10.71%) is ABOVE TREND, confirming the positive catalyst. WMT (+45): Baird raised its target; WMT (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +11.03%) is ABOVE TREND, also confirming. V (+45): Bernstein raised its target; V (1W: +0.80% | 1M: +8.87%) is ABOVE TREND, consistent with the news.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
MPC (-50): target cut; MPC (1W: -8.84% | 1M: -15.10%) is BELOW TREND, confirming weakness. VLO (-50): target cut; VLO (1W: -9.53% | 1M: -19.56%) is BELOW TREND, confirming. UNH (-50): Medicare plan exits announced; UNH (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +7.03%) is ABOVE TREND, a price-sentiment divergence to monitor.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; Leadership: neither narrow nor broad (Top 5 across 3 sectors).
CHTR (1W: +17.81% | 1M: +30.82%) and LOW (1W: +8.67% | 1M: +25.74%) are showing relative strength, both ABOVE TREND.
Major technology-stock divergences and bearish Energy sentiment remain key risks; monitor UNH (1W: +0.17% | 1M: +7.03%), ABOVE TREND, for continued divergence.
